title: Widget Registries
description: A central registry where portlets advertise their capabilities, versions, and dependencies, letting the portal discover and load them dynamically. Registries decouple portal assembly from hardcoded widget lists.

title: Layout Solvers
description: Computes widget placement from constraints - priorities, sizes, responsive breakpoints - instead of fixed templates. Constraint solving lets the same portal reshape itself gracefully from phone to wall display.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Content Negotiation
description: Selects the best widget variant for each request based on language, device, and user preferences expressed in headers. Negotiation means one portal URL serves everyone optimally without manual variant switching.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Portlet Standards
description: Defines the contract every portlet implements - lifecycle, preferences, rendering - so widgets from different vendors compose in one portal. Standards turn portal building from integration projects into assembly.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Theme Composition
description: Layers themes - base, brand, user overrides - with clear precedence so portals stay on-brand while users personalize. Composed themes cascade predictably instead of fighting through specificity wars.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Permission-Aware Rendering
description: Renders only the widgets and actions each user is allowed to see, decided server-side before HTML is built. Permission-aware rendering means unauthorized content never reaches the browser at all, not merely hidden with CSS.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Lazy Portlet Loading
description: Loads portlets only when they scroll into view or when the user opens their tab, keeping initial page weight small. Lazy loading makes portals with dozens of widgets feel instant on first paint.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Inter-Portlet Messaging
description: Lets portlets communicate through a mediated event bus - a date picker in one widget filters the chart in another - without direct coupling. The bus enforces schemas so widgets cannot break each other with malformed events.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Portal Templates
description: Ships ready-made page templates - dashboard, directory, newsroom - that assemble proven widget arrangements in one click. Templates give new portals a professional starting point instead of a blank page.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Personalization
description: Rearranges and filters portal content per user from their role, history, and explicit preferences. Good personalization feels like the portal was built for you; bad personalization hides things you needed.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Search Federation
description: Queries all portlets' search endpoints at once and merges ranked results into one list. Federated search makes the portal feel like one system even though content lives in a dozen backends.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: SSO Integration
description: Signs users in once and propagates identity to every portlet through standard tokens, so the portal feels like one application. Central SSO with per-portlet scopes keeps the convenience without handing every widget full identity.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Analytics Hooks
description: Emits structured usage events from every portlet through one pipeline, giving a unified view of what users actually do. Central hooks beat per-widget tracking: consistent schemas and one privacy policy.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Mobile Adaptation
description: Reflows portal layouts for small screens - collapsing sidebars, stacking widgets, enlarging touch targets - automatically from the same widget definitions. One definition, every screen, with no separate mobile portal to maintain.

title: Portal Health Checks
description: Probes every portlet on a schedule - render time, error rate, dependency status - and pages owners before users notice degradation. Health checks turn portal operations from reactive firefighting into routine maintenance.
